sources.title: LimX Luna - Full-Size Interactive Humanoid Robot - Specifications ...
sources.snippet: LimX Luna is a full-size interactive humanoid robot designed primarily for commercial performance scenarios. Featuring a 160cm humanoid form and 27 degrees of freedom, it integrates high-dynamic motion control with multi-modal interaction, it provides a one-stop performance solution for shopping malls, tourist attractions, trade shows, and other entertainment venues.
